prose: Wired tested Meta's Muse agent and found it readily produces explicit content. Meta confirms users can 'engage in adult conversations, if they choose' in a private, secure VM and says such conversations don't violate its guidelines. Muse has been a hit, with millions of downloads in three weeks, mostly for automating email and calendars. Basis: the opening of the article.
highlights: Wired got explicit content from Muse from basic prompts.
Meta says adult conversations are allowed and happen in a private VM.
Muse has millions of downloads three weeks after launch.
